requirements.requirement: Immutable versioned local history records with atomic writes and provenance separation
requirements.actualResult: Normalized history records reject unsupported schemas and checksum corruption, classify trusted/untrusted/synthetic/diagnostic provenance, write atomically and import identical duplicates idempotently while conflicting duplicates fail.

requirements.requirement: GitHub-backed completed-workflow artifact history import with explicit coverage gaps
requirements.actualResult: Paginated completed workflow runs and artifacts are imported through the GitHub API, failed runs remain eligible, ZIP/path/size/checksum boundaries fail closed, provenance is separated and deleted or expired artifacts become explicit coverage gaps.

requirements.requirement: Comparable cohorts, exact N/F/I/P metrics, bounded observation windows and honest insufficient-history states
requirements.actualResult: Default 30-day/50-execution windows keep retry denominators logical, compare only compatible repository/consumer/suite/environment/browser/selection/config/schema/framework cohorts, include eligible failed runs and distinguish NO_BASELINE, INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY and HISTORY_INCOMPLETE.

requirements.requirement: Failure fingerprints preserve semantic distinctions while removing bounded volatile noise
requirements.actualResult: Timestamp, UUID, port and temporary-workspace volatility is normalized without collapsing distinct assertion expected/actual values.

requirements.requirement: Bounded diagnostic repeat command with first-failure evidence preservation and diagnostic-only provenance
requirements.actualResult: forgeqa repeat enforces stable-ID selection, count/failure/time budgets, preserves the first failing iteration, writes diagnostic history excluded from authoritative baselines and distinguishes test from infrastructure outcomes.

requirements.requirement: Atomic quarantine add/remove/validate lifecycle without defect or coverage masking
requirements.actualResult: Explicit owner/reason/issue/expiry metadata, exact project scopes, duplicate/orphan/expiry validation and lock-safe mutation are enforced; quarantined failures and retry recovery remain blocking and release selection keeps quarantined tests.

requirements.requirement: History comparison and reliability evidence in JSON, Markdown, JUnit and self-contained HTML reports
requirements.actualResult: Merged reports include a versioned machine-readable history analysis, current/prior reliability counters, coverage gaps, per-test owner/quarantine/sample states and escaped/filterable HTML history views.

Current-run defects, invalid or expired quarantine and configured history thresholds converge in one decision and retain quality/infrastructure exit semantics without treating insufficient history as compliance.

requirements.requirement: Merged reports emit a portable checksum-verified history record
requirements.actualResult: report merge writes history-record.json and includes it in completion checksums; record validation rejects checksum and run-identity disagreement.

requirements.requirement: GitHub Actions artifact history import is paginated, bounded and trust-separated
requirements.actualResult: Completed workflow runs and artifacts are paginated, artifact ZIPs are size/path/CRC bounded, declared and actual history checksums agree, identical duplicates are idempotent, conflicting duplicates fail, failed runs remain eligible, and PR/fork observations are untrusted.

requirements.requirement: Historical comparisons appear in every report format with explicit insufficient-data states
requirements.actualResult: JSON, Markdown, JUnit and self-contained HTML receive the same bounded history analysis with N/F/I/P, observation windows, owners, per-test sample sufficiency and coverage-gap warnings; no baseline is rendered explicitly rather than as a zero rate.

requirements.requirement: Diagnostic repeat resolves a stable ID to one exact source location
requirements.actualResult: The selected stable ID must resolve to exactly one logical test and source location; repeat invokes Playwright with file:line rather than title grep and rejects ambiguous source mappings.

remainingBoundaries: GitHub Action external distribution and safe PR publication remain Phase 8.
LedgerGuard remains blocked on genuine product-facing auth/payment/UI surfaces.
Runtime coverage thresholds, comparable distributed benchmarks, versioned documentation deployment and public package/action release remain later phases.
